name: OpenClinica
postCreateCommand: (bash .devcontainer/setup-pi.sh || echo 'Pi setup failed, continuing') && COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.demo.yml bash docker/test/reset-demo-data.sh --yes
postStartCommand: source docker/test/base-url.sh && docker compose -f docker-compose.demo.yml up -d && bash docker/test/print-url.sh

LITELLM_URL.description: Base URL of the LLM API for the Pi coding agent, for example https://api.example.com/v1

LITELLM_API_KEY.description: API key for the LLM API used by the Pi coding agent
